name: addonKit
description: The single entry point for MoltenCodes addons: MoltenCodes:For(...) with lazily resolved Kits, an addon object over ModuleKit, databases from plain defaults, and one-call options panels and minimap launchers, with errors that say the fix.
summary: The single entry point for addon authors: `MoltenCodes:For(...)` with every Kit by name, an addon object over ModuleKit, databases from plain defaults, and one-call options panels and minimap launchers, with errors that say the fix.

Composition.description: MC:Options (an options panel with its slash command) and MC:Launcher (a minimap button kept in the profile).

Database.description: MC:Database (a SettingsKit database from AceDB-style defaults, the schema inferred), MC.Range and MC.Enum.
